summary: Diff adds a new Motoko backend actor with profile/listing/rental types and several frontend pages/components for auth, listings, rentals, routing, and a warm (non-blue/purple) theme. However, stable persistence/upgrade handling is not evidenced in the backend snippet, and a few implemented behaviors appear beyond the stated requirements (e.g., admin secret initialization and extra rental status variants).

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement stable persistence across upgrades for all core records (profiles, listings, rental requests/bookings) in the backend, preserving existing data during canister upgrades.
missing_requirements.reason: The added backend uses in-memory `Map.empty` for `profiles`, `tools`, and `rentals` and the shown portion does not include any `stable var` storage or `system` `preupgrade`/`postupgrade` hooks (or a migration module) to persist/restore state across upgrades.

hallucinated_features.description: Additional rental status variants `cancelledByOwner` and `cancelledByRenter` instead of a single `Cancelled` status.
hallucinated_features.reason: Requirements specify statuses: Requested, Approved, Declined, Cancelled, Completed. The backend introduces two cancellation variants which were not requested and may diverge from the specified status set.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin/secret-based access-control initialization from a URL parameter (`caffeineAdminToken`) and calling `_initializeAccessControlWithSecret`.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest requires Internet Identity auth and basic access control for owners/involved parties, but does not request a secret token URL parameter mechanism or admin bootstrap behavior.
Not requested by any REQ; adds user-facing content beyond marketplace requirements.
